python3 -c "
import math

# Values from Money in Circulation table (in millions of dollars)
jan_1952 = 28386
jan_1953 = 29691

# Continuous rate of change = ln(Y1/Y0) / 1
rate = math.log(jan_1953 / jan_1952) / 1

print(f'Jan 1952: {jan_1952}')
print(f'Jan 1953: {jan_1953}')
print(f'Ratio: {jan_1953 / jan_1952}')
print(f'ln(ratio): {math.log(jan_1953 / jan_1952)}')
print(f'Continuous rate: {rate}')
print(f'Rounded to thousandths: {round(rate, 3)}')
"
